title: Population Count
statement: Create a combinational unit that counts the number of 1 bits in an 8-bit input and outputs the count. This is useful for Hamming weight calculations and error checking circuits.
module_signature: module population_count(input [7:0] a, output reg [3:0] count);
behavior: count is the number of ones in a.
The output must be correct for any 8-bit input.
No sequential or register-based counting is allowed.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use sequential loops or memory-based counters.
hint: Use a tree of bitwise adders or reduction logic.
